intro: A board is a view: it shows the emails that meet the conditions below, wherever they stand. It moves nothing.
name: Name
shared: Shared with every member of the organisation
confirmDelete: Delete the board “{name}”? Its emails stay where they are.
empty: No email meets the conditions of this board.
filterIntro: An email is shown when it meets every condition given. A condition left empty keeps every email.
anyWhenNone: With nothing ticked in a line, that line keeps every email.
receivedWithin: {days, plural, one {In the last day} other {In the last # days}}
fromPlaceholder: a name, an address, a domain
keywordsHint: Every word must appear in the subject or the text.
